## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant module
contract or issue when useful.

## Verification

List checks actually run and any infrastructure blockers. Identify synthetic
fixtures and distinguish rendering checks from financial/database validation.

## Review

- [ ] Scope follows CONTRIBUTING.md and preserves PAPER ONLY.
- [ ] Financial changes preserve exact decimals, causal provenance and independent capital; focused regressions are included when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private exports or operational evidence are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is current; import disclosure and existing attribution are preserved.
